🔒 CWE-208 OWASP:A02-Security CVSS:5.9 | Using === to compare secrets enables timing attacks. The comparison short-circuits on first mismatch, leaking information about the secret. | HIGH
   Fix: Use crypto.timingSafeEqual() for constant-ti

🔒 CWE-338 OWASP:A04-Cryptographic CVSS:5.3 | Math.random() is not cryptographically secure. It uses a PRNG that can be predicted. Never use it for tokens, keys, passwords, or any security-sensitive values. | CRITICAL
   Fix: Use crypto.ran

🔒 CWE-798 OWASP:A04-Cryptographic CVSS:9.8 | Credentials detected in URL query parameters - this is a security risk | CRITICAL [SOC2,PCI-DSS,HIPAA,GDPR]
   Fix: Use secure methods: POST body, headers (Authorization), or secure cookies | ht
